items.front: Passage timeline of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.
items.back: Bill in AP Assembly 5 Dec 2013; Lok Sabha 18 Feb 2014; Rajya Sabha 20 Feb 2014; President's (Pranab Mukherjee) assent 1 Mar 2014; Appointed Day 2 Jun 2014 (Telangana formed).
items.examPoint: The Act, the Appointed Day & the Capital Question

items.front: Structure of the Act — sections, parts, schedules.
items.back: 108 Sections, 12 Parts, 13 Schedules. It also amended the First & Fourth Schedules of the Constitution. Telangana = 10 districts.
items.examPoint: The Act, the Appointed Day & the Capital Question

items.front: Section 5 — Hyderabad as common capital, for how long?
items.back: Common capital for a period NOT exceeding 10 years (from 2 Jun 2014 → up to 2 Jun 2024), then Telangana's. Sec 8: Governor has special responsibility for law & order in the common-capital area.
items.examPoint: The Act, the Appointed Day & the Capital Question

items.back: Central expert committee headed by K.C. Sivaramakrishnan to study new-capital options within 6 months. AP later chose Amaravati (greenfield, land pooling).
items.examPoint: The Act, the Appointed Day & the Capital Question

items.front: Seat allocation: Lok Sabha, Assembly, Council, Rajya Sabha.
items.back: Lok Sabha: AP 25, Telangana 17 (of 42). Assembly: AP 175, Telangana 119 (of 294). Legislative Council: AP 58, Telangana 40. Rajya Sabha: AP 11, Telangana 7.
items.examPoint: The Act, the Appointed Day & the Capital Question

items.back: Movable assets/cash split ~58:42 by population; immovable go to State where located. 9th Schedule = govt companies; 10th Schedule = continued-facility institutions; employees per Kamalanathan Cttee.
items.examPoint: Division of Assets, Liabilities, Institutions & Employees

items.back: Declares Polavaram Irrigation Project (Godavari) a National Project; Union controls/executes it and secures clearances; Telangana consent deemed given. Funding scope remains an AP-Centre dispute.

items.front: Section 85 — river boards; which HQ where?
items.back: Created KRMB & GRMB under the Union (Apex Council chaired by Union Water Minister). KRMB HQ in AP; GRMB HQ in Telangana. Sec 89 extended Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal; Sec 91 Tungabhadra Board.

items.front: Thirteenth Schedule — key institutions promised to AP.
items.back: IIT, NIT, IIM, IISER, Central University, Petroleum University, Agricultural University, IIIT, an AIIMS-type hospital, a Tribal University, and NIDM.
items.examPoint: Thirteenth Schedule Commitments, SCS Debate & Status (2026)

items.front: Thirteenth Schedule — infrastructure promises & their status.
items.back: Dugarajupatnam major port (unrealised), Kadapa (YSR) integrated steel plant (partial), VCIC corridor, new railway zone (South Coast Railway sanctioned 2019, live 1 Jun 2026), airport upgrades.
items.examPoint: Thirteenth Schedule Commitments, SCS Debate & Status (2026)

items.back: 13th FC award apportioned; President referred to 14th FC for separate awards → 14th FC gave AP a revenue-deficit grant. Special development package to focus on Rayalaseema & north-coastal regions.
items.examPoint: Division of Assets, Liabilities, Institutions & Employees

items.front: Special Category Status — was it in the Act?
items.back: NO — SCS was a verbal PM assurance in Rajya Sabha (Feb 2014), not a statutory clause. After the 14th FC the Centre called SCS 'no longer relevant' and offered a Special Package (2016). Not granted.
items.examPoint: Thirteenth Schedule Commitments, SCS Debate & Status (2026)

items.front: Common Governor & High Court after bifurcation.
items.back: A common Governor served both States for a period fixed by the President; common High Court at Hyderabad until AP's separate High Court was established (Jan 2019, at Amaravati).
items.examPoint: The Act, the Appointed Day & the Capital Question
